    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The stack is a labelled region ("Notifications (F8)"); every toast is focusable
      - listitem: New and updated toasts are read out in a polite status region – errors in an alert region, so they come first
      - listitem: The timer pauses while the pointer or keyboard focus is in the stack and while the tab is hidden, so nothing vanishes mid-read
      - listitem: "Swiping is never the only way out: there's Esc and a named close button"
      - listitem: Icons are decorative; color is limited to the status icons (green, red, blue for info), the text says what happened
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: New toasts lift in from the edge; the ones behind move back, shrink a little and peek out
      - listitem: Hover or focus fans the stack out into a list – every toast is measured, so positions and heights glide
      - listitem: "Promise toasts: the spinning arc closes into a ring while a check or cross draws in; the text crossfades and the card resizes"
      - listitem: Closed toasts fade and sink a few pixels while the rest of the stack moves up; swiped toasts fly out in the swipe direction, short swipes rubber-band back
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly – only the spinner keeps turning
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: 356px wide on larger screens; under 600px it spans the width with 12px gutters (and respects the home indicator)
      - listitem: "Touch: tap the stack to fan it out, swipe sideways or down to dismiss; close and action buttons get bigger hit areas"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Render <Toaster /> once; call toast() from event handlers or effects, not during render
      - listitem: Use toast.promise for async work instead of separate loading and success toasts
      - listitem: Keep titles to a few words and put details in description
